title: The Gaslighting of San Francisco at the Hunters Point Shipyard
author: Greg M. Schwartz
content:
Hunters Point Naval Shipyard, image by Chris Michel. The cleanup at the former
Hunters Point Naval Shipyard along the bay in San Francisco’s southeast corner
remains a huge headache for the Navy, the City, and the citizens of the
Bayview/Hunters Point neighborhood. The shipyard was listed as an EPA
